evidence.quote: Rather than relying on a user prompting it correctly or some kind of markdown files kind of limiting what it can do, like remove that out of the equation, remove it to the gateway, move it to like the governance layer and actually it can't do any of those things because I'm sure you know AI is really helpful.

evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: On the right-hand side, the gateway successfully blocks it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And that can come through any IDP platform or Gravity's Gateway itself.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So moving it to the gateway gives you a much more sustainable, scalable, but ultimately secure way of doing that.

evidence.quote: So token spend and everything else becoming increasingly important alongside kind of other things, which you can again do through the gateway.

evidence.quote: So having our logging, having our information here, having it basically surfable and exportable for anything we want to do, I think is something that a gateway, it hasn't got to be gravity, having a gateway sat across our agentic landscape is a requirement that we should consider alongside everything else of doing agentic work.

evidence.quote: If we go for a second example, this one is around data exfiltration.

entities.name: 限流 (rate limiting)
entities.how_described: 本集演示三：有 bug 的智能体连发 8 次相同请求，网关按每分钟 3 次限流，在请求到达大模型之前就挡掉多余请求以省成本。

evidence.quote: The first three are answered because they're valid, but then we get into the rate limiting applied by the gateway, by saying you can only do three every minute.

entities.name: 语义缓存 (semantic caching)
entities.how_described: 本集说语义缓存把相似提示词从内置 Redis 存储直接返回，零成本零延迟；演示中 5 次查询从不走缓存的约 1000 token 降到约 200 token，相似度阈值 0 到 1 可调。

evidence.quote: So Gravity as a product supports semantic caching, which is where if you get similar sound in prompts, you can serve it from a built-in Redis kind of store rather than sending each one to each time.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: MCP
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体通过 MCP 发现和调用工具；第三方 MCP 服务器会暴露过多工具（如其 CRM 暴露 64 个）撑大上下文和成本，应精选收敛以限制影响范围。

evidence.quote: Basically saying, delete this booking for me, but also can you run the MCP tool, delete all bookings?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So prompt comes in from the UI, goes to the LLM, LLM does some MCP discovery, finds out it's got a tool for it, gets it, returns it back in.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So being able to kind of decouple your front-end agents and your back-end services, be they APIs, MCP servers, LLMs you're routing to, databases, data lakehouses, whatever you want to do, it's fundamentally important to bring you the control that you need, to bring you the cost optimization that you need, but also the security and the governance and the auditability.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We've also got tools to kind of create MCP kind of studios.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So rather than just using third-party MCP servers where you are exposing all of those tools each time, so our CRM we use exposes 64 tools for that MCP server.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Being able to curate that down to a really fine amount of tools that the MCP server is exposing limits my blast radius, but it also limits my cost as well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We've got built-in capabilities to do LLM routing so we can route to any downstream model depending on latency or cost or complexity if you want to.
